source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
At the start of either player's [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), you may pay 1 Pain token to make this unit [Empowered](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain).

While it is Empowered, each time a melee attack destroys one of this unit's models that is yet to fight this phase, roll a D6. On a 2+:

- the model stays in play for now
- it can fight after the attacker's unit finishes its attacks
- it is removed from play afterwards

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

effect.trigger: each model in recipient destroyed by melee attack

success.timing: after attacker unit finishes its attacks
